_about: busway_ampacity as found and every ladder rung, for the four shipped intakes, as produced by base commit b649b3e7 (before the optional lv.existing_busway_load_kW input existed). The input absent must reproduce this byte for byte.

busway: 10 run(s) at 800 A derated to 0.8 -> 4,300 kW (E0); this ASSUMES a rack's load can be shared across runs (A and B feeds): if each rack is fed from one run, declare lv.rack_feed_topology = single_run and whole racks are counted run by run. Modelling limit: the figure is the INSTALLED busway total as declared; existing load and occupied positions are not subtracted, so the rack count is overstated if the figure is not the hall's spare capacity
